programs.title: Joel Osteen
programs.desc: Author and evangelist Joel Osteen spreads his message of love and hope as he preaches at the 30,000-plus member Lakewood Church in Houston. The program can be seen in more than 100 countries. Osteen urges people to live at their full potential and form a close relationship with God.

programs.title: RateEscape: Stop Overpaying For Cellular
programs.desc: Cut up to half the cost of your monthly cell phone bill; same towers, same coverage, but a lot less money; it sounds great but is it too good to be true?; join myth-busting legend Kari Byron as she takes on Big Wireless to save you money.

programs.title: I Am Somebody's Child: The Regina Louise Story
programs.desc: A woman tries to adopt an African-American girl, but due to a racially motivated ruling, the two are forced apart. The woman does not give up on the girl and continues to be her lifeline until they can be reunited.

programs.title: Faith & Forgiveness: A Duck Dynasty Love Story
programs.desc: Al and Lisa Robertson's relationship becomes strained under the weight of betrayal and unspoken pain. With their marriage and faith hanging by a thread, both must decide if love is worth fighting for, and what it truly means to forgive.

programs.title: Trapped in the Rocky Mountains
programs.desc: Lured into an unwelcome reunion at a vacant ski lodge, former college friends find themselves in a fight for their lives when they become the target of an unseen adversary.

programs.title: Couples Retreat Murder
programs.desc: Becky and Jim head to a remote couple's retreat to try and save their marriage. However, when one of the guests goes missing and their host is found dead, they start to wonder who else they're trapped with on the trip.
